Working together

Sustainable transformation requires coordinated effort

Comfort Foundation believes no single organisation can deliver community transformation alone. We actively build partnerships across systems — and we are straightforward about what each side brings.

01
Government Agencies

Ministry of Health, Ministry of Community Development, Gender and Social Welfare, and local government authorities — aligning our programmes with national priorities.

02
Schools & Health Facilities

Delivering programmes where communities already gather and already trust.

03
NGOs & Civil Society

Collaborating to reduce duplication and amplify collective impact.

04
International Development Partners

Seeking grants and technical support from aligned foundations and bilateral agencies.

05
Private Sector

Engaging businesses in livelihood training, market linkages, and co-funding.

Tell us about your organisation

We will review your enquiry and respond with a clear next step — usually a short call to explore fit.

Stay close to the work

Occasional updates on our programmes, results and opportunities to help.

A community-rooted, women-centered Tanzanian NGO working at the intersection of economic empowerment, family resilience, and children's mental health.
